name: Terisia City
description: City where the Third Path gathered; it fell after a siege.

description_citations.text: "Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl go to Terisia City and create the Union of the Third Path with the Archimandrite and the Brotherhood of Gix.
timeline.quote: they created the Union of the Third Path

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon co-founds the Union of the Third Path and meets Loran.
timeline.quote: Feldon was one of the Third Path 's founders, and it was here that he met the Argivian woman Loran , another founder.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon receives the Golgothian Sylex and Coral Helm from the Yumok and learns magic from Hurkyl.
timeline.quote: He also started learning magic from Hurkyl , eventually learning to tap into the red mana of his mountain home.

citation.text: "Feldon", section "The Third Path". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra sends Hajar to besiege Terisia City, and after months the Brotherhood of Gix betrays the Third Path, leading to the city's fall.
timeline.quote: the Brotherhood of Gix betrayed the Third Path to Mishra, leading to the Fall of Terisia City .

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl unsummons a group of artificial killing machines during the battle.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl used a magical spell to unsummon a group of artificial killing machines

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon sends Loran away with the Golgothian Sylex since his lame leg would slow her; she is captured by Ashnod and tortured.
timeline.quote: Loran did as she was bid, but she was captured by Ashnod who tortured her

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Loran travels from Penregon to Terisia City and meets the scholars at the Ivory Tower.
timeline.quote: She arrived at the Ivory Tower and there met Feldon

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Yumok deliver the Sylex to Feldon; Feldon and Loran feel darkness on touching it.
timeline.quote: they felt a darkness come over them as if the sun had fallen behind an eclipse

citation.text: "Loran", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra conquers Sarinth while Urza annexes Korlis and Sardia, and Ashnod obtains the Golgothian Sylex at Terisia City.
timeline.quote: Ashnod obtains a Thran artifact called the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower invites the first members of the Third Path.
timeline.quote: As its first members, the Archmandrite of the Ivory Tower invited the Abbot from the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Third Path studies lead to the foundation of the modern schools of Magic and the use of colored mana on Terisiare.
timeline.quote: their studies led to the foundation of the modern schools of Magic and the use of colored mana on Terisiare

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terisia City falls after a siege; Feldon and Loran flee with the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: The Third Path suffered heavy losses during the Fall of Terisia City

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As Terisia City burns, Feldon presses the sylex into Loran's hands and urges her to run.
timeline.quote: As Terisia City burned, Feldon pressed the sylex into Loran's hands and urged her to run.

citation.text: Loran's Escape (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Terisia City opens its ivory towers to all who sought respite from the war.
timeline.quote: Terisia City at last opened its ivory towers to all who sought respite from the endless war.

citation.text: Union of the Third Path (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Corlo prepares as Mishra's army bears down on Terisia City.
timeline.quote: As Mishra's army bore down on Terisia City

citation.text: Third Path Savant (The Brothers' War, 2022), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl arrive in Terisia City from the College of Lat-Nam.
timeline.quote: both Hurkyl and Drafna were fully shaved bald

citation.text: "Drafna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drafna is present for the Fall of Terisia City, where Hurkyl dies unsummoning three dragon engines.
timeline.quote: his wife Hurkyl died after unsummoning three dragon engines

citation.text: "Drafna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A grieving Drafna takes charge of the defenses and has artifacts shuttled out through secret tunnels.
timeline.quote: A grieving Drafna took charge of the defenses

citation.text: "Drafna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon, aided by Loran, secretly smuggles the Golgothian Sylex out another way.
timeline.quote: Feldon was aided by Loran in secretly smuggling the Golgothian Sylex out

citation.text: "Drafna", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra, denied support by the city council, sends his armies to besiege Terisia City.
timeline.quote: His armies were then sent to besiege Terisia City for their refusal.

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix betrays the city and opens the gates to the Fallaji.
timeline.quote: finally betrayed the city after several months of siege, and opened the gates to the onslaught

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl dies as a defender after casting the spell later named Hurkyl's Recall.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl died as one of the defenders

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terisia City is sacked under Hajar; the Ivory Towers are razed and the city burned.
timeline.quote: The beautiful Ivory Towers were all razed to the ground, and the rest of the city burned to cinders.

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feldon gives the Sylex to Loran to flee with.
timeline.quote: so he gave it to Loran and asked her to flee with him on her quick legs

citation.text: "Fall of Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terisia City falls after Mishra's siege; Hurkyl is killed.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl was among those who were killed

citation.work: Fall of the College of Lat-Nam
citation.text: "Fall of the College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drafna removes valuable artifacts, leaving only books for Mishra, who is enraged.
timeline.quote: leaving only books and scrolls for Mishra to find

citation.work: Fall of the College of Lat-Nam
citation.text: "Fall of the College of Lat-Nam", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra sends Hajar and his armies to besiege Terisia City; defenses hold for months until Gixians betray the city.
timeline.quote: When diplomacy failed, he sent Hajar and his armies to besiege the city.

citation.text: "Hajar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl dies casting a spell to disappear Mishra's dragon engines.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl died as one of the defenders

citation.text: "Hajar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Invited to Terisia City, Hurkyl joins others to establish the Union of the Third Path, seeking neutrality in the Brothers' War.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl joined her husband, Feldon , Chayum-Icha , Kathwar , and others to attend meetings to establish the Union of the Third Path .

citation.text: "Hurkyl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl teaches meditation techniques to pupils including the Archimandrite.
timeline.quote: She taught her techniques to an increasingly growing crowd of pupils, including the Archimandrite .

citation.text: "Hurkyl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra's forces breach Terisia City; Hurkyl vaporizes three dragon engines, then is killed by spearmen.
timeline.quote: She was killed by invading spearmen right afterwards.

citation.text: "Hurkyl", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terisia City hosts the Union of the Third Path in 33 AR.
timeline.quote: In 33 AR , Terisia City was host to the Union of the Third Path

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After banishing Ashnod, Mishra, listening to the Brotherhood of Gix, becomes inclined to raze Terisia City.
timeline.quote: Mishra became inclined to raze Terisia City

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terisian defenses hold the Fallaji at bay for months while civilians are evacuated through secret passages.
timeline.quote: The Terisian defenses were implacable and held the Fallaji at bay for months

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gixians betray the city and open the gates.
timeline.quote: They eventually betrayed the city and opened the gates to the onslaught.

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl dies defending the city, casting a spell that makes three dragon engines vanish.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl died as one of the defenders

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Terisia City is sacked by forces under Hajar and burned; Feldon and Loran escape through tunnels.
timeline.quote: Terisia City was sacked by forces under the command of Hajar and burned to cinders.

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ruined city is used as a military base and taken and retaken several times.
timeline.quote: This location was taken and retaken several times afterwards.

citation.text: "Terisia City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hurkyl, Drafna, Feldon, Chayum-Icha, Kathwar and others meet with the Archimandrite to establish the Third Path as a neutral alliance.
timeline.quote: to establish the Third Path , also known as the "Union".

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Archimandrite shows aptitude at Hurkyl's meditative technique and names the energies "mana".
timeline.quote: The Archimandrite showed great aptitude at this

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra decides to eradicate Terisia City; Hajar's Fallaji besiege it for months.
timeline.quote: Mishra decided to eradicate Terisia City.

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix betrays the city and opens the gates, leading to its fall.
timeline.quote: They finally betrayed the city and opened the gates to the onslaught

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Archimandrite participates in the defense and possibly falls with the city.
timeline.quote: The Archimandrite participated in the defense of the city and possibly fell along with it

citation.text: "The Archimandrite", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
